response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS rel_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.rel_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cat.n) AS avg_budget_lines, AVG(cat.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM cat CROSS JOIN a WHERE cat.n > a.avg_n

assumptions.assumption: The 'average category' line count is the unweighted mean of per-category line counts across all categories in budget; only categories strictly above it are kept.

Lines with amount = 0 (division by zero) or NULL spent/amount yield a NULL ratio and are ignored in the per-category average; a category whose ratios are all NULL is ignored in the cross-category average.
Budget lines with a NULL category, if any, are treated as one group.
